dcterms:description: A dataset containing 5,001,460 daily Tweets crawled from Twitter using the online streaming API, focusing on sentiment related to four tech companies: Apple, Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, over a period from April 1, 2011 to May 31, 2011.
dcterms:title: Twitter Sentiment Dataset for Tech Stock Prediction

dcterms:description: A gold-standard dataset of 3665 manually labeled Tweets related to tech companies, used for training and testing a Named Entity Recognition (NER) system to identify named entities such as persons, organizations, hardware, and software.
dcterms:title: Named Entity Recognition Dataset for Tech Tweets
